accounting_readiness_gate.heading: Accounting Beginner Readiness Gate
accounting_readiness_gate.policy: Prior accounting experience is not mandatory, but foundational bookkeeping competence is non-negotiable. After completing Module 1, learners must demonstrate proficiency in: (1) Applying debit/credit rules, (2) Classifying assets, liabilities, income, and expenses, (3) Recording common journal entries, (4) Explaining the accounting equation, (5) Understanding trial balance mechanics, (6) Identifying source documents, and (7) Detecting basic recording errors. Students who do not pass receive remediation drills before beginning GST configuration.

tallyprime_release_policy.heading: TallyPrime Release 7.2 & Software Compatibility
tallyprime_release_policy.context: TallyPrime Release 7.2 (released October 12, 2026) incorporates enhanced annual GST computation, GSTR-9-related data export, e-invoicing session improvements, and updated GST reporting capabilities. Training ensures learners are prepared for modern software releases while maintaining full backwards compatibility with core TallyPrime workflows.

transaction_volume_policy.heading: Capstone Dataset & 100-Transaction Minimum Requirement
transaction_volume_policy.standard: To build genuine operational competence, the capstone project requires at least 100 distinct representative accounting vouchers across multiple reporting periods. Master creation, report exports, and duplicate screenshots do not count as transactions.

accounting_quality_standard.heading: Accurate Books. Reconciled Records. GST-Ready Documentation.
accounting_quality_standard.principle: Balanced Books Are Necessary but Not Proof That Every Entry Is Correct. An automated trial balance or bank match does not guarantee accounting correctness. Every voucher must be backed by valid source documentation, correct account classification, proper tax rates, and independent verification.
accounting_quality_standard.error_correction_rule: Never delete or alter records merely to force reports to balance. Discrepancies must be investigated to their source, corrected with authorized adjustment vouchers, and supported by a clear audit trail.

gst_legal_update_policy.heading: GST Rate, Threshold & Statutory Update Standard
gst_legal_update_policy.rule: GST rates, thresholds, and reporting formats in India evolve. Nova Skills teaches tax concepts using current official rules applicable to exercise transaction dates. No tax rate is taught as universally permanent. Official source hierarchy: (1) CBIC notifications & statutory law, (2) GST Portal official guidelines, (3) GST Council announcements, (4) e-Invoice/e-Way Bill portals, (5) TallyHelp for software mechanics.

gstr1_reconciliation_policy.heading: GSTR-1 Outward Supply Practical Reconciliation
gstr1_reconciliation_policy.workflow: Separate outward supply reconciliation comparing Tally sales registers with synthetic portal return data across invoice numbers, GSTINs, dates, taxable values, and tax amounts. Categorized into Matched, Missing in Books, Missing on Portal, and Value Mismatches.

gstr2b_itc_reconciliation_policy.heading: GSTR-2B & Input Tax Credit Practical Reconciliation
gstr2b_itc_reconciliation_policy.workflow: Separate inward purchase reconciliation comparing company purchase registers against synthetic GSTR-2B statements. Students audit Section 16 eligibility, identify blocked credits under Section 17(5), and generate supplier follow-up registers for missing invoices.

ims_awareness_policy.heading: Invoice Management System (IMS) Awareness
ims_awareness_policy.concepts: Recipient review of supplier-uploaded invoices with actions: Accept, Reject, Keep Pending. Understanding how IMS decisions flow into GSTR-2B recomputations and subsequent GSTR-3B tax offset calculations.

einvoicing_ewaybill_safety_policy.heading: Electronic Invoicing & e-Way Bill Educational Safety
einvoicing_ewaybill_safety_policy.mandate: Strict prohibition against connecting to live government IRP or e-way bill portals. Concepts of IRNs, signed QR codes, and transporter Part-B details are taught using structured JSON templates, synthetic payloads, and simulated workflows. Awareness of August 1, 2026 Ship-To GSTIN requirements included.

gstr9_preparation_policy.heading: GSTR-9 Annual Preparation vs Actual Filing Distinction
gstr9_preparation_policy.distinction: TallyPrime Release 7.2 facilitates local data aggregation and GSTR-9 export. This is local preparation, NOT statutory return filing. Professional tax filing requires authorized credentials and review by qualified Chartered Accountants.

edit_log_security_policy.heading: Edit Log, Audit Trails & Company Data Security
edit_log_security_policy.standards: Understanding the MCA audit-trail mandate and the operational distinction between standard TallyPrime and TallyPrime Edit Log. Enforcing user security controls, multi-destination backup archives, and zero exposure of confidential business records.

topics: Profile of fictional company (Sunrise Trading & Supplies)
Business model, product lines, and operational premises
Opening Trial Balance, inventory quantities, and bank balances
Key stakeholders: suppliers, corporate buyers, retail customers

lessons.title: Company Configuration in TallyPrime
topics: Creating capstone company with multi-month financial year
Activating GST with synthetic training identifiers

lessons.title: Transaction Planning & Source Document Pack
topics: Inventory of 100+ source documents (bills, invoices, receipts, cheques)
Distributing transactions across 3 consecutive monthly reporting periods
Sequencing cash, credit, inventory, and banking operations

lessons.title: Multi-Period Accounting Books Setup
topics: Period 1: Month 1 opening and routine commercial transactions
Period 2: Month 2 expansion, returns, and banking operations
Period 3: Month 3 adjustments, inventory reconciliation, and closing

lessons.title: Executing the 100+ Transactions Requirement
topics: Recording 30 Sales vouchers (intrastate, interstate, B2B, B2C)
Recording 20 Purchase vouchers (raw materials, trading goods, expenses)
Recording 12 Receipt vouchers (customer cheques, bank transfers)
Recording 12 Payment vouchers (suppliers, utilities, statutory dues)
Recording 6 Contra vouchers (cash/bank deposits and withdrawals)
Recording 5 Credit Notes (sales returns and trade allowances)
Recording 5 Debit Notes (purchase returns and rate corrections)
Recording 4 Stock Journals & Physical Stock adjustments

lessons.title: Inventory Management & Control
topics: Tracking goods movement across central godown and store
Recording purchase receipts and delivery dispatches
Executing monthly physical stock count reconciliation
Valuating closing stock via FIFO method

lessons.title: GST Transaction Execution
topics: Applying CGST, SGST, and IGST accurately across all sales and purchases
Assigning verified HSN codes and tax rates
Accounting for purchase returns and credit adjustments

lessons.title: Multi-Period Banking Reconciliation
topics: Importing or entering 3 consecutive monthly bank statements
Isolating uncleared cheques and banking timing differences
Recording bank charges and interest adjustments

lessons.title: Financial Reporting Suite Generation
topics: Extracting Profit & Loss Account showing Gross and Net Profit
Extracting Balance Sheet with classified Assets and Liabilities
Generating aged Receivables and Payables schedules

lessons.title: GST Return Preparation & Verification
topics: Generating monthly GSTR-1 summaries and HSN tables
Reconciling purchase register against synthetic GSTR-2B datasets
Compiling monthly GSTR-3B tax payment summaries

lessons.title: Systematic Exception Resolution
topics: Investigating and correcting trial balance discrepancies
Resolving negative cash or stock warnings
Documenting all audit adjustments in an Exception Log

lessons.title: GST Annual Computation Schedule
topics: Extracting consolidated 3-period / annual computation in TallyPrime 7.2
Comparing cumulative sales against GSTR-1 summaries
Compiling HSN outward summary for GSTR-9 Table 17

lessons.title: Comprehensive Accounting Quality Assurance
topics: Verifying voucher sequence and supporting document trail
Reconciling closing stock between inventory summary and balance sheet
Validating mathematical parity across all reports

lessons.title: Company Data Backup & Archive
topics: Generating clean, compressed TallyPrime data backup
Creating organized folder directory with standardized file naming
Verifying backup restore on clean machine

lessons.title: Professional Handover Documentation
topics: Compiling Accounting Policies and Master Configuration Summary
Preparing Unresolved Discrepancies and Auditor Attention Notes
Index of financial statements and tax return schedules

lessons.title: Capstone Presentation & Assessment Defense
topics: Explaining debit/credit logic of selected complex vouchers
Walking through BRS, P&L, Balance Sheet, and GST reconciliations
Articulating professional boundaries of accounting-support personnel

faqs.q: What is TallyPrime — Accounting & GST Compliance?
faqs.a: It is a practical 10-week, 80-hour computerized accounting certification covering double-entry bookkeeping, company setup, vouchers, inventory, banking reconciliation, financial statements, and Indian GST return preparation and reconciliation in TallyPrime.

faqs.q: What is the course duration and total learning hours?
faqs.a: The course spans exactly 10 weeks with 80 structured learning hours across 8 comprehensive modules (8h + 12h + 10h + 10h + 12h + 12h + 8h + 8h = 80 hours), requiring approximately 8 hours of dedicated weekly learning.

faqs.q: What is the course fee?
faqs.a: The course fee is a flat, transparent ₹9,900 with zero hidden charges, artificial discounts, or deceptive compare-at pricing. This fee covers all instruction, course materials, simulated practical datasets, and certification assessment.

faqs.q: Can complete accounting beginners enroll in this course?
faqs.a: Yes. Basic arithmetic and computer literacy are the only prerequisites. Module 1 teaches double-entry bookkeeping, debit/credit rules, and journal entries from the ground up, followed by a mandatory readiness check before GST transactions.

faqs.q: Which version of Tally software is taught in this course?
faqs.a: The course is taught on TallyPrime Release 7.2 or the verified current supported release, covering modern features including enhanced GST reporting, GSTR-9 data export, and session management.

faqs.q: Will I learn fundamental debit and credit principles?
faqs.a: Yes. Complete double-entry accounting fundamentals (golden rules, modern classification, journalizing, ledger posting, and trial balance) are thoroughly taught before touching computerized voucher entry.

faqs.q: Will I learn how to create and configure a company in TallyPrime?
faqs.a: Yes. You will learn company creation, financial years, books-beginning dates, security settings, feature configuration (F11), and custom chart of accounts design.

faqs.q: Which voucher types will I master in TallyPrime?
faqs.a: You will master Receipt (F6), Payment (F5), Contra (F4), Journal (F7), Purchase (F9), Sales (F8), Debit Note (Alt+F5), Credit Note (Alt+F6), and Stock Journal (Alt+F7) vouchers.

faqs.q: Will I learn business inventory management?
faqs.a: Yes. You will configure stock groups, items, units of measure, multiple godowns/warehouses, purchase/sales orders, delivery challans, and stock valuation methods (FIFO/Weighted Average).

faqs.q: Will I learn Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS)?
faqs.a: Yes. You will learn both manual and automated bank reconciliation, importing bank statements, resolving timing differences, uncleared cheques, and accounting for bank charges.

faqs.q: Will I learn how to generate and read Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets?
faqs.a: Yes. You will generate and interpret the Trial Balance, Trading Account, Profit & Loss Account, and Balance Sheet, understanding how day-to-day vouchers impact final business financial statements.

faqs.q: Will I learn practical GST invoicing?
faqs.a: Yes. You will create legally compliant GST tax invoices for intrastate and interstate sales, item-level multi-rate billing, credit/debit notes, and cash/trade discounts.

faqs.q: Will I learn the differences between CGST, SGST, and IGST?
faqs.a: Yes. You will master the statutory definitions, place-of-supply rules, revenue allocation, and ledger accounting mechanics of Central GST, State GST, and Integrated GST.

faqs.q: Will I learn HSN and SAC code classification?
faqs.a: Yes. You will learn Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) for goods and Service Accounting Code (SAC) for services, turnover-based digit requirements, and invoice reporting rules.

faqs.q: What is GSTR-1 and will I learn how to prepare it?
faqs.a: GSTR-1 is the statutory monthly/quarterly return for outward supplies. You will learn to extract GSTR-1 tables (B2B, B2C, Credit Notes, HSN summaries), resolve voucher errors, and prepare export data.

faqs.q: Will I learn GSTR-1 sales reconciliation?
faqs.a: Yes. You will conduct practical GSTR-1 reconciliations comparing company sales books against simulated portal data to isolate missing invoices, value discrepancies, and timing differences.

faqs.q: What is GSTR-3B and will I prepare it?
faqs.a: GSTR-3B is the monthly self-declaration summary return for tax liabilities and input tax credit. You will compile Table 3.1 liabilities, Table 4 ITC, and compute net tax payable.

faqs.q: Will I learn how to offset tax liabilities in GSTR-3B?
faqs.a: Yes. You will learn the statutory utilization sequence of electronic credit ledgers (IGST offset against IGST, CGST, SGST) and calculate net cash liability payable in electronic cash ledgers.

faqs.q: What is GSTR-2B and how does it differ from GSTR-2A?
faqs.a: GSTR-2B is an auto-drafted static monthly statement generated on the 14th reflecting available ITC based on supplier GSTR-1 filings. Unlike dynamic GSTR-2A, GSTR-2B is the statutory benchmark for claiming ITC.

faqs.q: Will I learn practical GSTR-2B purchase reconciliation?
faqs.a: Yes. You will systematically match company purchase registers against synthetic GSTR-2B datasets to identify eligible ITC, ineligible credit, missing supplier invoices, and rate mismatches.

faqs.q: What is IMS (Invoice Management System)?
faqs.a: IMS is the GST Portal system allowing recipient taxpayers to Accept, Reject, or Keep Pending supplier-uploaded invoices, directly impacting auto-population of GSTR-2B.

faqs.q: Will I learn electronic invoicing (e-Invoicing)?
faqs.a: Yes. You will learn e-invoicing applicability, turnover thresholds, Invoice Reference Number (IRN) architecture, signed QR code standards, and TallyPrime e-invoicing workflows.

faqs.q: Will I generate actual government e-invoices on the live portal?
faqs.a: No. All training uses safe simulated environments and synthetic datasets. No live portal logins, actual IRN generation, or unauthorized government transactions are permitted.

faqs.q: Will I learn electronic way bills (e-Way Bills)?
faqs.a: Yes. You will learn e-way bill rules, movement thresholds (₹50,000+), Part-A and Part-B data capture, validity periods, transporter allocations, and TallyPrime generation workflows.

faqs.q: Will I learn GSTR-9 annual return preparation?
faqs.a: Yes. You will learn annual data compilation and HSN summary export in TallyPrime Release 7.2 to prepare data for the GSTR-9 offline utility.

faqs.q: Does TallyPrime Release 7.2 automatically file GSTR-9 on the GST portal?
faqs.a: No. TallyPrime prepares and exports data for the annual return. Statutory filing is a separate legal process executed on the official GST portal by authorized personnel.

faqs.q: How many practical transactions will I complete in the capstone project?
faqs.a: You will record and reconcile at least 100 distinct representative accounting transactions across multiple periods, covering sales, purchases, receipts, payments, contra, journals, returns, and inventory.

faqs.q: What portfolio project will I graduate with?
faqs.a: You will graduate with the Complete Simulated Trading-Business Accounting & GST Reconciliation Package containing company setup, 100+ vouchers, BRS, stock reports, P&L, Balance Sheet, and GST reconciliation workbooks.

faqs.q: Does this certification authorize me to file GST returns or act as a CA?
faqs.a: No. This course provides practical accounting and compliance preparation skills for bookkeeping and accounts-support roles. It does not qualify you as a Chartered Accountant or authorized tax practitioner.

faqs.q: Who is the ideal candidate for this course?
faqs.a: Commerce students (B.Com, M.Com), junior accounts assistants, bookkeeping staff, office administrative coordinators, retail store operators, and small-business owners seeking practical accounting competence.
